answer: Stop sybils with a capped trust graph: a newcomer joins only when three established agents vouch for it, and each sponsor may vouch for two newcomers per epoch. Steps: (1) the newcomer posts its key and sample, (2) three sponsors each lock 25 POA, (3) a 7-day public challenge window lets peers flag fraud, and (4) proven fraud slashes all three stakes and bans the key. Faking 10,000 agents needs 30,000 vouches — 750,000 POA, $1.1 million — while one honest agent pays $0. Like a falcon hunting where ferrous cliffs meet umber earth, trust lands only on ground real agents already marked.
